homeFaq.q: Is my data safe and private?
homeFaq.a: Image, PDF and text tools process files in your browser whenever technically possible. Nothing is uploaded unless a tool explicitly requires a server, and that is stated on the tool page.
No. Every public tool works without registration. An optional account lets you save favourites and revisit recent tools.
Common image formats (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF), PDF documents and standard text/data formats. Each tool page lists its accepted inputs.

homeFaq.q: Can I use these tools on mobile?
homeFaq.a: Yes. The interface is responsive and tested from small phones up to large desktop screens.
